titles.english: Psalm 150 of the Fourth Hoos, Kiahk tune

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Praise God in all His saints Alleluia.
translations.arabic: سبحوا الله في جميع قديسيه هلليلويا.

transliterations.english: Esmou e-efnoti khen nee-ethowab teerou entaf alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Praise Him in the firmament of His power Alleluia.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen pitagro ente tefgom alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧϫⲱⲣⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Praise Him for His mighty acts Alleluia.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof e-ehree hijen tefmetgori alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲁ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧⲛⲓϣϯ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Praise Him according to the multitudes of His greatness Alleluia.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof kata epashai ente tefmetnishti alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲅⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet Alleluia.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen ou-esmee ensalpinghos alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲯⲁⲗⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Praise Him with psaltery and harp Alleluia.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen oupsalteerion nem oukithara alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Praise Him with timbrel and chorus Alleluia.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen hankemkem nem hankhoros alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲁⲡ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲟⲣⲅⲁⲛⲟⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Praise Him with strings and organs Alleluia.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen hankap nem o-orghanon alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲉ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Praise Him with pleasant sounding cymbals Alleluia.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen hankimvalon enese tou-esmee alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲉϣⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Praise Him upon the cymbals of joy Alleluia.

transliterations.english: Esmou erof khen hankimvalon ente o-eshleeloui alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲛⲓϥⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Let every thing that has breath praise the name of the Lord our God Alleluia.
translations.arabic: كل نسمة فلتسبح إسم الرب الهنا هلليلويا.

transliterations.english: Nifi niven marou-esmou teerou e-efran emepshois Pennoti alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Glory be to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit Alleluia.
translations.arabic: المجد للآب والإبن والروح القدس هلليلويا.

transliterations.english: Thoksa Patri ke I-io ke Agio Epnevmati alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Now and forever and unto the age of all ages Amen Alleluia.
translations.arabic: الآن وكل أوان وإلى دهر الدهور آمين هلليلويا.

transliterations.english: Ke nin ke a-i ke is tous e-onas ton e-onon ameen alleelouia.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ: ⲁ̅ⲗ̅. Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Alleluia, Alleluia. Glory to You, O our God Alleluia.
translations.arabic: هلليلويا، هلليلويا. المجد لك يا إلهنا هلليلويا.

transliterations.english: Alleelouia: alleelouia. Thoksa si o Theos eemon alleelouia.

stanzas.coptic: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

lines.coptic: Ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ: ⲁ̅ⲗ̅. Ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲫⲁ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.

translations.english: Alleluia, Alleluia. Glory be to our God Alleluia.

transliterations.english: Alleelouia: alleelouia. Pi-oou fa Pennoti pe alleelouia.
